backup.production_rule: Counts keep learning and a missed refill is record-only (lane S10). Adds the nullable column inventory_usage_intervals.refill_recorded_qty (check > 0; the table stays closed, no API grant). Patches three live bodies in place with md5 guards (CR stripped, 55000 on a body that is neither the expected original nor already patched): reconcile_inventory_baseline_v1 (original 7cbb2ea861268b3fbe848c974e32b2f2) no longer sets movement_controlled_at for an active consumable that is not controlled, still writes baseline_reviewed_by and baseline_note and the movement, and only when this call wrote the movement (created_at = now()) anchors it through record_inventory_anchor_v1 inside a begin/exception warning guard; inventory_undo_v1 (original b3923b0bae57e812bb8375eea81f93e9) removes the interval of an undone reconcile when it is the item's newest and recomputes; get_inventory_usage_kpi_v1 (original f0a2052c3ccc56673808d000ba21d189) no longer lets an ordinary purchase clear the waiting-for-refill prompt. New record_missed_refill_v1(uuid, numeric): security definer, empty search_path, execute for authenticated only, admin_require manage_inventory; never changes stock or writes a purchase; completes the newest 'unrecorded restock' interval with the quantity (consumed = qty_prev + received_between + qty - qty_now; below 0 is too_small with the minimum), re-runs the same reasons as the anchor function, sets last_refill_at and last_refill_qty under the receipt-path guard, recomputes, writes one inventory_audit_log row (action missed_refill). Phase is backfill because the guard for expand phases rejects the delete from the undo hook contains; no row is deleted by the migration itself. S11 (Opus review fixes, edited in place, never applied): an app count writes an app_count audit row and its undo an app_count_undo row (both outside the warning guards) so inventory_qty_at_v1 sees app counts; new internal helper s_inventory_refill_mark_sync_v1 (no grants) keeps last_refill_at/last_refill_qty true after a purchase delete (trigger function s_inventory_refill_mark_after_delete_v1 now calls it) and after the undo of a count. Expected md5s of the patched reconcile and undo bodies, the trigger function and the helper are in forward_verification. The rollback restores the original trigger function and drops the helper.
backup.notes: Apply AFTER the usage-learning release (20261120000000 and its successors): the migration stops with 55000 when the intervals table or the anchor and recompute functions are missing. Rollback runs BEFORE the usage rollback. Counts already made stay counts: an item kept in learning stays in learning.
